glosses: Any poem or short written piece composed in the style of Theocritus's short pastoral poems, the Idylls.
An episode or series of events or circumstances of pastoral or rural simplicity, fit for an idyll; a carefree or lighthearted experience.

raw_glosses: (music) A composition, usually instrumental, of a pastoral or sentimental character, e.g. Siegfried Idyll by Richard Wagner.

examples.text: My fellow-creatures, from whom I was thus separated, began to assume idyllic virtue and beauty in my memory.
examples.ref: 1896, H. G. Wells, “chapter 17”, in The Island of Dr. Moreau:

examples.text: The rest of the road was as idyllic as the start.

I think I learned more from my family than they did from me in the brief idyllic time we spent together. None of them much more than a mile from home, they carried the aura of a close-knit community as a shield against against the unknown.
